dog.description_text:
Leo is a sweet kitty who is looking for a purrrrever home! Could it be with you?

If this animal is in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. If this animal is located at our Manhattan or Westhampton Adoption Centers, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Leo
